bluetooth.title: Set up the discovered Huawei AH100
bluetooth.description: Set up the first profile and shared scale connection options below. After submitting, close Huawei Health, weigh barefoot, and stand still until the scale finishes. Sensors populate after Home Assistant receives an actual measurement.

data_description.allow_bind: Enable only when this adapter is not authorized by the scale and binding is needed. Binding can change the existing association; leave off if already authorized.
